title: Crash or blank screen when TileMapLayer has exactly rendering/gl_compatibility/item_buffer_size tiles
body:
### Tested versions

Reproduced in 4.6.0 mono and 1eb0374e5f3efa05d8a9914f482b894b5b1f6b9c mono.

### System information

Godot v4.7.dev.mono (1eb0374e5) - Fedora Linux 43 (Workstation Edition) on Wayland - X11 display driver, Multi-window, 3 monitors - OpenGL 3 (Compatibility) - NVIDIA GeForce GTX 970 (nvidia; 580.126.18) - Intel(R) Core(TM) i7-6700 CPU @ 3.40GHz (8 threads) - 23.36 GiB memory

### Issue description

A TileMapLayer with exactly as many tiles as the rendering/gl_compatibility/item_buffer_size setting can disappear, or in some cases crash. On default settings, a 128x128 grid triggers the bug.

The MRP below causes the disappearing tiles. I haven't been able to reduce the crash to an MRP but I strongly suspect it's the same issue.

Backtrace:

It appears to hit a boundary condition in drivers/gles3/rasterizer_canvas_gles3.cpp, in `_render_items`. Specifically, the [`index == 0`](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/456bdea954ee24e48cb562bfbf531de1cd96e371/drivers/gles3/rasterizer_canvas_gles3.cpp#L664) case is triggered when the batch size limit is hit exactly. In that case, `_add_to_batch` resets `index` to 0. Then the function skips rendering even though 16864 items should be rendered.

It also skips some cleanup at the end of `_render_items`, which I suspect (but haven't confirmed) is the cause of the crash.

### Steps to reproduce

There's also a sprite in the scene. If you toggle its visibility on and off, the tilemap's visibility is also toggled, demonstrating how the bug only occurs when the batch limit is exactly hit.
